bin_rule: Use maximum physical residual over every source closed cell intersecting a bin, including shared endpoints. Never sample or restart history.
weight_rule: Upper endpoint of J0(T-left)-J0(T-right), generated with the original 100-bit outward dyadic moment primitives.
low_node_rule: Reuse the separately checked same-field time-local 0<=u<=64 CF radii, retaining their dependency hashes.
high_node_rule: min(Btrue+|phi_reference|, min(1,|phi_reference|)*(exp(eta)-1)); use the second term only if full-history approximate real part and startup nonpositivity both certify.
price_rule: Recompute all nonzero reference nodes, signed ref-fast centre, full reference arithmetic, strip grid and genuine infinite tail beyond128. Old/new complete error intervals may be intersected only after distinct centres are retained.
